acceptance.text: Fresh install and adoption of an existing supported install; no loss of unrelated files/configuration.
A second run creates no duplicate services, profiles, skills, jobs, accounts, or MCP entries.
Interrupted download/install resumes; package/network/DNS failures and disk exhaustion produce actionable errors and recoverable state.
Failed updates preserve the prior working generation; database backup and compatible restore actually work.
Registry discovery/validation, source-to-runtime mapping, missing dependency handling, inheritance, skill reference integrity, and profile isolation.
Actual enforcement of enabled registry boundaries, including denial tests; prompt text alone must not pass these tests.
Native Desktop launch, backend connection, a basic “Hello” response, cancellation, restart, and one harmless tool workflow.
Provider inference and tool calls, account-ineligible states, rate limiting, no unapproved paid fallback, and private-data routing—including memory extraction and retries.
GLM-5.2 artifact identity, actual ARM64 engine execution, measured resource/performance report, and a bounded failed/too-slow path. A small test model must not substitute for this target test.
Coral inference on the TPU, with an honest pending-hardware result when the device is unavailable.
MCP functional tests, Playwright fixture screenshot, and the selected memory provider's cross-session retrieval test.

Representative end-to-end tests for each integration class, plus a concrete verification method/status for every individual component. Heavy browser/render/indexing workloads must leave core chat usable within documented limits.

note: Test paths are planned semantic contracts, consolidated many-to-one where appropriate. Luna may record concrete test functions/commands in the mutable evidence ledger while preserving every assertion; text/manifest presence does not prove runtime functionality.

critical_scenarios.scenario: Wrong graphical user or disabled sandbox
critical_scenarios.when: the Desktop launch fixture has no selected-user display session, or its only successful launcher requires --no-sandbox
critical_scenarios.then: the adapter SHALL report native Desktop unavailable, SHALL NOT start a root/headless or unsandboxed native GUI, and SHALL preserve an agent/browser fallback with separate status; the native-window acceptance remains pending/failed

critical_scenarios.when: an existing Home Assistant service occupies the requested port and its config contains a sentinel not owned by this installer
critical_scenarios.then: plan SHALL report the collision and an explicit alternate/configure-later route; install SHALL NOT stop/replace that service, change its sentinel bytes or count it as installer-owned

critical_scenarios.when: aggregate metered budget is zero and the free configured route fails while a proxy advertises a paid default fallback
critical_scenarios.then: dispatch SHALL reject the paid route before any HTTP request, keep the requested free model identity unchanged, return an unavailable-route result and record zero paid-endpoint calls across delegated/background retries

critical_scenarios.scenario: Private derived context cannot reach free endpoint
critical_scenarios.when: a Google read/tool result is classified private and its summary, system context or memory extraction attempts the configured Nemotron public-only endpoint with no eligible private route
critical_scenarios.then: the actual dispatcher SHALL return private-route-unavailable before network dispatch for each derived/retry/background request; the recording endpoint SHALL receive zero private requests and no automatic fallback SHALL relabel the data public

critical_scenarios.when: the provider fixture returns429 with Retry-After3s, configured attempts are3 and total deadline10s, then cancellation is requested
critical_scenarios.then: retry SHALL respect Retry-After while within the configured total limits; cancellation SHALL stop pending dispatch, attempts SHALL NOT exceed3, no paid/disallowed model SHALL be contacted and status SHALL distinguish quota/rate-limit/cancel from authentication

critical_scenarios.when: the live-model fixture allows tools/tool_choice but lacks response_format and is text-only while a component asks for structured-output mode or screenshot understanding
critical_scenarios.then: the adapter SHALL omit unsupported parameters and deny the unavailable vision capability with an explicit compatible-provider next step; skill availability SHALL NOT label the task operational

critical_scenarios.when: two profile workers reference one supported OAuth host credential whose refresh token is single-use and one refresh request succeeds
critical_scenarios.then: the host broker SHALL serialize refresh ownership and expose only authorized references/results; it SHALL NOT copy reusable token values into profile roots/argv/logs or let the second worker race the consumed refresh token

critical_scenarios.when: a Skill requires tool@^2.0.0 but the catalog contains tool@1.0.0, or two profiles extend each other
critical_scenarios.then: resolution SHALL fail closed with the precise selector/cycle/source paths, leave the prior active generation intact, register the affected capability unavailable and SHALL NOT rewrite the dependency optional

critical_scenarios.when: generation A is active, a staged generation B adds a filesystem/network/tool permission or conflicts with a private learned overlay
critical_scenarios.then: B SHALL remain quarantined with a readable permission/overlay diff and no active-pointer switch; A/private overlay bytes SHALL remain intact until a separately authorized compatible resolution is accepted

critical_scenarios.scenario: Fresh membership and bounded broker denial
critical_scenarios.when: the correlated principal has a previously cached System role but the current Authentik lookup fails, resolves a different identity or no longer confirms effective membership
critical_scenarios.then: the infrastructure broker SHALL receive zero mutation calls, authorization SHALL fail closed and no prompt/group/request field, schedule or previous success SHALL substitute for the fresh decision

critical_scenarios.scenario: Indirect membership and fresh alarm recipients
critical_scenarios.when: the Authentik fixture confirms an active principal through an unambiguous current child-group path to System while a previously authorized recipient has been removed
critical_scenarios.then: only operations within the configured bounded broker/account/target scope SHALL be permitted for the current member, and alarm delivery SHALL separately resolve current recipients and exclude the removed user; arbitrary shell/SSH remains denied

critical_scenarios.scenario: Direct specialist and cross-session route rejected
critical_scenarios.when: an external channel requests profile=developer or presents another user session/correlation ID
critical_scenarios.then: the runtime SHALL reject direct specialist binding and cross-session access before handing context/tools to that specialist; any accepted internal result SHALL return through the correlated Orchestrator then Hermes with contributor/evidence/dissent metadata

critical_scenarios.scenario: Wrong engine or model identity refused
critical_scenarios.when: the target reports aarch64 but the engine artifact is ELF x86_64, or the selected artifact identifies GLM-5.3/a smaller model instead of GLM-5.2
critical_scenarios.then: staging/activation SHALL fail with the exact architecture/model mismatch, SHALL NOT execute the wrong binary or substitute the model, and requested GLM-5.2 acceptance SHALL remain failed/pending

critical_scenarios.when: usable available space is430GB while required final GLM files plus temporary/conversion staging and configured OS/user/recovery reserve exceed430GB
critical_scenarios.then: plan SHALL show each required quantity and deny the large download before allocation, retain any existing model reference and offer a resumable storage-path next step without deleting user data or duplicating a generic model backup

critical_scenarios.when: actual full GLM-5.2 target measurements are warm TTFT40s and generation0.5token/s with configured limits30s and1token/s
critical_scenarios.then: the report SHALL retain exact cold/warm/model/engine/target metrics and classify the route experimental/manual; it SHALL NOT become the interactive default or mark a small test model as passing GLM acceptance

critical_scenarios.when: the official compiled sample returns a valid result but its runtime records CPU execution/no EdgeTPU delegate despite device enumeration
critical_scenarios.then: TPU functional verification SHALL fail with delegate-not-used evidence; enumeration/CPU output SHALL NOT count as inference on Coral, and missing USB/PCIe hardware SHALL instead report pending-hardware

critical_scenarios.scenario: Memory owner switch and namespace isolation
critical_scenarios.when: OpenViking is the active capture owner for user A/profile P and the user selects claude-mem, while another user B requests A's synthetic fact
critical_scenarios.then: the switch SHALL flush/stop A's prior owner before activating the new owner and SHALL NOT run two automatic capture streams; B's retrieval SHALL be denied/no private fact returned, preserving native session memory

critical_scenarios.scenario: Restart persistence and recursive ingestion exclusion
critical_scenarios.when: a synthetic fact has been extracted by the selected memory provider, its worker/profile is restarted and a new session requests that fact
critical_scenarios.then: retrieval SHALL return the fact with user/profile/source provenance; generated-memory output SHALL NOT be captured recursively, and export/backup/removal SHALL operate only on the selected namespace

critical_scenarios.scenario: Sanitized server and separate extraction costs
critical_scenarios.when: the inherited Hermes environment contains unrelated provider tokens but the selected OpenViking server only needs its configured local references, and extraction/embedding has no eligible budget/private route
critical_scenarios.then: server startup SHALL pass an explicit sanitized environment allowlist without unrelated tokens; automatic lazy installs SHALL remain disabled and extraction/embedding dispatch SHALL fail before paid/ineligible network calls while reporting the missing capability

critical_scenarios.scenario: Markdown alone is not a working hook
critical_scenarios.when: a skill directory is discovered but the requested bootstrap/hook/command host feature has no invoked adapter or produced callback effect
critical_scenarios.then: portable instructions SHALL remain discoverable with exact references, but the executable feature SHALL be unsupported/instruction-only and SHALL NOT be marked functionally tested merely from Markdown presence

critical_scenarios.when: a selected MCP fixture initializes and lists tools, then returns401 after revocation or a harmless read exceeds its configured2s deadline
critical_scenarios.then: authenticated/functional states SHALL become false/failed with exact cause; reconnect SHALL be bounded and the slow optional server SHALL NOT indefinitely block a separate basic chat request or reuse revoked credentials

critical_scenarios.when: the Google fixture discovers both read and message/document/calendar mutation tools, and installation tests request selected service resources
critical_scenarios.then: only configured minimal-scope harmless reads SHALL execute; send-message/create-meeting/modify-document calls SHALL be denied before side effects and service/account-preview eligibility SHALL be reported separately

critical_scenarios.scenario: Existing entity read without device control
critical_scenarios.when: an existing HA MCP instance exposes one selected entity state and a control tool while the setup verifier runs
critical_scenarios.then: verification SHALL read only the selected exposed state, preserve the existing HA deployment and deny all real device-control/replace-instance actions during setup

critical_scenarios.scenario: Selected project read without billing mutation
critical_scenarios.when: the RevenueCat fixture account selects project P while discovery includes product/entitlement/customer/subscription mutation tools
critical_scenarios.then: the verifier SHALL use an allowlisted read for P and deny mutation/cross-project access before any side effect; successful discovery alone SHALL NOT mark the connection functional

critical_scenarios.when: the Playwright adapter opens a new isolated profile against a local fixture with an accessible labeled button
critical_scenarios.then: verification SHALL navigate, record the accessibility snapshot and save/inspect a screenshot artifact with digest using the native ARM64 browser/sandbox; it SHALL NOT import personal cookies or count --no-sandbox as a supported solution

critical_scenarios.when: a path inside the managed root is a symlink to an unrelated outside directory containing a sentinel and install/restore attempts to write through it
critical_scenarios.then: the ownership/filesystem layer SHALL reject the write before following the symlink, preserve outside sentinel bytes and report the unsafe path with an actionable selected-root next step

critical_scenarios.scenario: Failed candidate update preserves old generation
critical_scenarios.when: working generation A is active and candidate B fails a health probe after staging a schema/config change
critical_scenarios.then: the active pointer/service/config SHALL remain or return to A, user modifications SHALL remain intact, B SHALL be recorded failed with rollback/resume evidence and no partial success label

critical_scenarios.when: a synthetic DB contains row alpha, a consistent schema-versioned backup is taken, alpha is changed/deleted, then a compatible restore runs
critical_scenarios.then: restored queries SHALL return the exact backed-up row and verified integrity in a staged destination before activation; corrupt/incompatible backup SHALL be rejected while preserving the prior live DB

critical_scenarios.when: the installer crashes after one owned service/config step is durably checkpointed, then resume and a second install run use the same intent
critical_scenarios.then: resume SHALL verify and reuse completed owned work, finish only pending steps and produce exactly one instance of each selected service/profile/skill/job/account/MCP entry; unrelated files/services SHALL remain byte-for-byte preserved

critical_scenarios.scenario: Fixture cannot turn live acceptance green
critical_scenarios.when: an item has valid source/configuration and passed x86 fixtures but its actual Pi/account functional test was not performed
critical_scenarios.then: the manifest/report SHALL keep installed/configured/functional/actual-target states distinct, report pending-live cause and exact resume command, and SHALL NOT promote fixture/source/configuration success to live full registry/MVP acceptance
